GreenTEC Pro from the BIO-Performance series by Extrudr was specially developed for high-performance applications. The material is characterized by good flexural strength and low warping as well as the high-quality surface. In addition, it remains dimensionally stable at temperatures of up to 160 ° C.
Manufacturer recommendation: Nozzle 210-230°C, bed 20-90°C, speed 40-60mm/s, cooling 30-80%, max 50% Layer height.

Polypropylene ULTRA, with its exceptional properties, makes it a very versatile material for prototyping as well as for the functional part.
The Armadillo Ultra is a Nylon-Kevlar (Aramid) filament, giving it unparalleled resistance to large impacts. Make your own custom bulletproof armor! Hardened steel nozzle and training compulsory.
The Flex93 ULTRA, finally a flexible (Shore 93A) that prints quickly! Print flex quickly with exceptional rendering.

ASA combines the qualities of ABS with the added benefit of UV resistance and additional moisture resistance making it ideal for equipment exposed to sunlight and rain over long periods of time – such as products for the agriculture, transportation, and power and utility industries.

The Acetate 3D filament is recognized for its biodegradable properties and its natural UV resistance. In addition, it is a material that behaves very well against chemical agents such as chlorine, which makes it a real asset in the printing of 3D parts intended for optics or intended to be in contact with the skin.
Zero warp technology

XYZprinting produces high quality, long lasting, ABS filaments that offer better impact resistance making it suitable for external components or model parts. Additionally, you can easily use common modeling tools to decorate, assemble or connect different parts to create your next big project.

Designed with antibacterial properties, our Antibacterial PLA (polylactic acid) greatly reduces the spread of germs and infections. It’s a material ideal for bringing 3D printing into daily lives, households, and schools.
Made from a mixture of PLA (polylactic acid) and carbon fiber, our XYZ Carbon Fiber filament lets you print 3D models with better impact resistance and an exotic finish.
3D Color-inkjet PLA is the filament designed for da Vinci Color to bring full color to your 3D-printed models.
PAHT CF15 is a tough, wear-resistant and oil-resistant wire with high strength and high density, which can show excellent surface quality and is not easy to warp during printing.
PET CF15 is a kind of wire with good toughness and good gloss, which can withstand high impact force to prevent breakage, suitable for printing card fasteners.

Made from a mixture of PLA (polylactic acid) and copper powder, our Premium Metallic PLA filament lets you print 3D models with a unique metallic finish and appearance.

* All images shown are for illustrative purposes only and may differ from the actual product. The weight of the Premium Metallic PLA is 600g.

XYZprinting Tough PLA is a biocompostible consumable that has better toughness than ABS and has stronger impact resistance than PLA. This allows you to create durable, impact resistant tools, accessories, and parts that make your finished product more reliable.
TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) filaments are tough, strong and durable, and shaped products are soft and elastic.

XYZprinting’s Thermoplastic Elastomer is a specially formulated filament that has elastic properties that provide flexible and durable prints. It is non-toxic and completely waterproof, making this a safe and resilient filament for all of your innovative projects.

PP is a semi-rigid and lightweight material. Its semi-crystalline structure causes 3D printed parts to warp easily when cooled. PP is tough and has good fatigue resistance, suitable for low-strength applications such as living hinges and belts.

This filament is ideal for users who desire a structural component with heat resistance, high strength and higher impact resistance.

Applications：
- Assembly testing
- Functional prototyping
- Tooling
- End-use parts
